text: The shop page is the home page (/). It loads its product list with a QUERY request (not a GET) to the API's /products, the filters in its JSON body (page, between, by_brand, is_rental): a wait for the list's reload matches /products whatever the method

A filter of the shop page is a level-4 heading written with a trailing colon (e.g. 'By brand:'), and its checkbox group is the heading's next sibling, not its child: getByRole('heading', { name }).locator('xpath=following-sibling::*[1]'), each checkbox named by its option

The list's pagination is buttons with aria-labels Previous, Page-N and Next (getByRole('button', { name: 'Next' })); on the last page Next stays clickable and only its parent li carries the class disabled
A product card is a[data-test=product-{id}] linking to /product/{id}, its name in data-test=product-name; the card shows no brand, GET /products/{id} gives it as brand {id, name}
GET /products answers a paginated object {current_page, data, from, last_page, per_page, to, total}; further pages with ?page=N; each product carries its brand nested as brand {id, name}

After a filter is ticked, the shop page re-renders its cards some time after the filtered QUERY /products has answered, and the filtered and unfiltered first pages can start with the same product: wait until the shown card ids match the answer's data ids, not for the response, networkidle or a change of the first name

The browser preflights the shop list's QUERY /products with an OPTIONS call to the same path: a wait for the list's answer skips OPTIONS. Unless the price slider is moved, every list request (load, filter tick, Next) carries between=price,1,100 and is_rental=false beside its filters and page: an API call meant to give the list the page shows sends the same parameters

Each product of GET /products and GET /products/{id} carries in_stock (boolean); a product's page is /product/{id}, ready when data-test=product-name shows (it loads GET /products/{id} and /products/{id}/related)
